verdict.rationale: Docs show explicit deadline/timeout controls with a 'return-partial' mode that returns completed work with a completion marker instead of waiting for full completion, directly enabling a latency-vs-completeness tradeoff, plus separate sync (small, fast) vs async batch (large, complete) crawl modes. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that return-partial behaves as documented under real load, and clearer guidance on tuning latency for extraction/answers endpoints specifically.
